title: Improvement proposals: check for duplicates, require evidence, bind approval to the reviewed issue (#1384)
body:
Fixes #1384.

Before I file an issue about my own improvement, `improvement__propose` now checks what already exists and needs evidence.

- New `node-bot/issue-proposals.js`: `findRelated` looks at exact #N references, `gh issue/pr list --search` (open and closed), roadmap lines and (optionally, once #1385 lands) open lessons. Each match shows its score and why; a failed search is kept in `limits`.
- Decision is only a suggestion: `link` (open match), `reopen-or-regression` (closed match) or `new`. Nothing is closed, reopened, merged or edited, and a match means nothing is filed; I tell the user and they decide.
- `propose` needs at least one evidence item, refuses a duplicate of a pending proposal (plus an in-process lock per title), and files through its own `improvement-issue` approval type with forceReview, so git-github grants and the GitHub "off" setting don't cover it. The approval is bound to a sha256 digest of the exact title/body/labels; the executor recomputes it and refuses on mismatch.
- Wiring: `improvement__propose` tool source in my own chat only (tier write, self-gated), small edits in server.js, ai/chat-reply.js and ai/tool-risk.js. `lessons` is left null until #1385 is merged.
- Tests in `test/issue-proposals.test.js` with a fake gh: renamed title, exact reference, closed regression, unrelated proposal filed after approval, search failure, no evidence, concurrent proposals, digest mismatch, denial.
interface: The merged change for PR #1404 is covered by test/issue-proposals.test.js.
why: Additional real merged-fix benchmark case selected to broaden the agentic coding evaluation.
